title: Chameleon in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tail: teal spiral -->
  <path d='M28 68 C14 68 10 54 18 46 C26 38 38 42 38 52 C38 60 30 62 26 56 C23 51 28 48 31 51' fill='none' stroke='#2ec4b6' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='62' rx='24' ry='16' fill='#3ddc84'/>
  <!-- lighter belly -->
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='70' rx='18' ry='8' fill='#8ef0b5'/>
  <!-- back ridge bumps -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='48' r='3' fill='#2ec4b6'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='46' r='3' fill='#2ec4b6'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='47' r='3' fill='#2ec4b6'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='50' r='3' fill='#2ec4b6'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='40' y='74' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#2ec4b6'/>
  <rect x='62' y='74' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#2ec4b6'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='88' r='5' fill='#3ddc84'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='88' r='5' fill='#3ddc84'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='76' cy='50' r='14' fill='#3ddc84'/>
  <!-- casque/crest -->
  <path d='M74 37 Q76 30 84 37 Q82 40 76 41 Z' fill='#2ec4b6'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='80' cy='47' r='6' fill='#fff06a'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='47' r='3' fill='#1a3a5c'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M80 56 Q84 59 88 56' fill='none' stroke='#1a3a5c' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- scarf around neck -->
  <path d='M66 60 Q74 66 84 60 L84 67 Q74 73 66 67 Z' fill='#f45b69'/>
  <!-- scarf tail hanging -->
  <path d='M69 67 L64 80 L70 82 L73 68 Z' fill='#ff8a95'/>
  <path d='M64 80 L70 82 L69 86 L63 84 Z' fill='#f45b69'/>
  <!-- scarf stripe -->
  <path d='M67 68 L65 76' stroke='#ffd23f' stroke-width='2'/>
  <path d='M72 68 L70 77' stroke='#ffd23f' stroke-width='2'/>
</svg>
